svg.title: MEDIVORAX — architecture
svg.desc: MEDIVORAX: Hospital pharmacy operations platform · Next.js · NestJS · PostgreSQL · OCR. Hospital pharmacies juggle supplier bills, stock, billing and a huge medicine catalogue in separate places. MEDIVORAX brings them onto one platform, with each hospital's data kept in its own database schema.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
